quests.title: The Toll Fields
quests.text: Mire-Cured Husks crowd the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} by day {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, at the deep end of the Causeway where the Accord's dead and ours lie mixed. Lay five down. I keep no list of their names; nobody pays me for that anymore.

quests.title: Ferrymen of the Last Ford
quests.text: Fordwater Zombies rise from the {name:front_broken_causeway/last_ford} after dark {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/last_ford}. Five of them, please. They were ferrymen once, and they still expect a coin.

quests.title: Group: The Last Toll
quests.text: War Construct Last-Toll stands in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct} and collects its toll in broken bones. It is too strong for one fighter. Bring a group and break it.

quests.title: Blightfangs in the Bonewood
quests.text: Past the Causeway the land turns to salt: Gravesalt Escarpment. Saltpack Blightfang Wolves hunt its {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood} by day {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}. Kill five; they have been gnawing on things I would rather bury.

quests.title: Deserters in the Tombs
quests.text: Saltroad Deserters hold the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_galleries} {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_galleries}, day and night, and rob the old tombs. Kill five. The dead are owed their grave goods, even the ones nobody remembers.

quests.title: Ashveil Watch
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch listens to the deep Escarpment, where the Last Watch still stands its post. You are ready for that. Go to Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise and tell Vaska I said so.

quests.title: Bounty: Bonewood Webs
quests.text: Salt-Web Bonelurker Spiders take the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood} every night {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood} and wrap whatever they catch. Kill five and collect. The next bounty opens twenty-five minutes after you hand them in.

quests.title: Salt in the Fen
quests.text: Saltbound Sun-Dried Husks wade through the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen} by day {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}; the salt keeps them walking long past their time. Lay five of them down.

quests.title: What the Hexes Say
quests.text: After dark Salt-Hex Bog Witches gather in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen} {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}. Kill four and bring me two Last-Hex Shards. I want to hear what their hexes say before I break them.

quests.title: Relieving the Whitewall
quests.text: Last-Watch Mummies stand guard on the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall} by day {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, deep in the Escarpment. Lay five to rest. The Last Watch kept its post well; it is time someone relieved it.

quests.title: Watch-Captain Huskell
quests.text: Watch-Captain Huskell commands the Last Watch from the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood} {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}. Destroy four Last-Watch Skeleton Raiders there at night, then Huskell. Tell him his watch is over; he will not believe you, so be convincing.

quests.title: Group: The Salt-Counter
quests.text: Bog Witch Salt-Counter counts every grain of salt in the Escarpment from her mire {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, and every soldier too. She is too strong for one fighter. Bring a group and end her counting.

quests.title: Bounty: Unquiet Bones
quests.text: Last-Watch Skeleton Raiders still patrol the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood} at night {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood}. Destroy five and bring me two Unquiet Bones; I listen to them, and then they are quiet. The next bounty opens half an hour after you hand them in.
